premises.text: Dyno uses nine integrated sensors and analytics to capture about 33 health metrics in ~60 seconds like a digital thermometer, via Bluetooth or a 3G/Wi-Fi cradle
premises.evidence_span: It's nine integrated sensors and analytics. It's able to track 33 different health metrics

premises.text: Analytics produce a 0–100 health score and grade and can alert care facilities to abnormalities (e.g. arrhythmia)
premises.evidence_span: our analytic software was able to identify and alert the facility of two abnormalities

premises.text: Go-to-market spans elderly care, chronic-disease/remote monitoring, hospital discharge/readmission, and consumer self-tracking
premises.evidence_span: In addition to elderly care, there are many other markets that we can go into

premises.text: Revenue via subscriptions, OEM/licensing, and eventually data mining
premises.evidence_span: Through subscription base, OEM and licensing revenue

value.text: Empower people and caregivers to take control of health through fast preventive monitoring that avoids costly acute events
value.evidence_span: empowering you to take control of your health

secondary_value.text: System cost savings from prevented strokes and similar events
secondary_value.evidence_span: how much it can save the system

causal_links.evidence_span: A true step forward in preventive care
Having the ability to track their health has dramatic implication on the quality of the care they're going to receive
